_meta.about: Small LongMemEval-S-shaped subset for the ADR-0006 advisory tier (issue #37, slice 1). NOT the official dataset: these are synthetic, license-clean, hand-authored entries that mirror the LongMemEval-S schema (question_id, question_type, question, answer, question_date, haystack_sessions, answer_session_ids, with answer-bearing turns flagged has_answer). They exist so the advisory harness runs deterministically offline with zero deps and zero network in the default path. The full 500q LongMemEval-S run and the model-judged answer-synthesis slice are gated behind --download / --judge and remain a TODO referencing #37.
